name: capybara-simulated-vendor
description: Build-time bundling for vendored JS deps and the bridge. The gem ships the pre-built bundles (`vendor/js/vendor.bundle.js`, `lib/capybara/simulated/js/bridge.bundle.js`); npm is needed only when updating them.

scripts.build:bridge: node script/gen_bindings.mjs --check && node script/check_bridge_globals.mjs && esbuild lib/capybara/simulated/js/src/bridge.entry.js --bundle --format=iife --keep-names --outfile=lib/capybara/simulated/js/bridge.bundle.js && node script/check_bridge_init_order.mjs
scripts.build: pnpm run build:vendor && pnpm run build:bridge
